metadata.question: In 2023, was there over 160,000 hectares of fires burning in Quebec?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use MODIS burned area product (MCD64A1) which is specifically designed for fire mapping. Time: 2023, Location: Quebec province. 2. Masking strategy: No cloud masking needed for burned area product, but we need to identify burned pixels and calculate area. 3. Logic: Calculate total burned area in hectares and compare to 160,000 threshold. Steps: - Get Quebec boundary from a reliable source (like GAUL administrative boundaries) - Load MCD64A1 burned area collection for 2023 - Extract burned pixels (where BurnDate > 0) - Calculate area of burned pixels (500m resolution = 25 hectares per pixel) - Sum total burned area and compare to 160,000 hectares Need to handle: - Check if collection is empty (C1) - Check if any burned pixels exist (C2) - Validate the calculated area is reasonable (C3) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions var quebec = ee.FeatureCollection("FAO/GAUL/2015/level1") .filter(ee.Filter.eq('ADM1_NAME', 'Quebec')); var startDate = '2023-01-01'; var endDate = '2023-12-31'; // 2. Data Acquisition - MODIS Burned Area product var burnedArea = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MCD64A1') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(quebec); var burnedAreaSize = burnedArea.size().getInfo(); print('2023 MODIS Burned Area Images:', burnedAreaSize); if (burnedAreaSize === 0) { print("No burned area data found for 2023."); print("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Create burned area mask and calculate area var burnedMask = burnedArea.select('BurnDate').max().gt(0); // Calculate area per pixel (500m resolution = 25 hectares per pixel) var areaImage = burnedMask.multiply(ee.Image.pixelArea()).divide(10000); // Convert m² to hectares // 4. Calculation - Sum burned area over Quebec var burnedStats = areaImage.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: quebec, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }); var totalBurnedArea = burnedStats.get('BurnDate').getInfo(); // Check for valid pixels var pixelCount = burnedMask.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: quebec, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('BurnDate').getInfo(); print('Burned pixels count:', pixelCount); if (pixelCount === 0) { print("No burned pixels detected in Quebec for 2023."); print("C2"); return; } // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (totalBurnedArea === null || totalBurnedArea === undefined || isNaN(totalBurnedArea) || totalBurnedArea < 0) { print("Invalid area calculation:", totalBurnedArea); print("C3"); return; } print('Total burned area (hectares):', Math.round(totalBurnedArea)); if (totalBurnedArea > 160000) { print("A"); } else { print("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
